points.description: First valid reason for charge on colloid surface, e.g. ionisation of surface active sites/groups (OH, COOH) depending on pH; or imperfection in crystal structure (isomorphous substitution, e.g. low-valency atoms replacing silicon giving net negative charge); or adsorption of anions (ions) onto particle surface.
points.partial_credit: Half mark if reason is vague (e.g. 'ionisation' or 'adsorption' with no surface groups/ions mentioned) or has a minor error.

points.description: Second, different valid reason from the same set (ionisation of active sites like OH/COOH depending on pH; crystal structure imperfection/substitution of lower-valency atoms; adsorption of anions onto surface).
points.partial_credit: Half mark if reason is vague or has a minor error.

rubric.notes: Award full marks for two different valid reasons, in any wording that carries the central idea (ionisation of surface groups, crystal imperfection/ion substitution, ion adsorption). Give part marks for a vague or slightly wrong statement of a reason. Repeating the same reason twice earns only one point; unrelated reasons earn nothing.
